prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Both ages the others argued over are already gone: citizen sensors last arrived 7 min ago [F3] and parking 12 min ago [F4], so neither Connector's alignment nor Observer's 9-and-19 gap survives the window — and 12 min is also RHMZ's age [F27], which proves only that fetchers run, not that anything was measured together. All three link facts hang on the same Blic cable-theft headline [F38][F39][F40] while Blic delivered nothing in the last 6 h, 0 of 96 slots [F25]: that is one stale string acting as an embedding hub, and the 4/5 surprise ratings are a small model's guess, not a measurement [F41]. The jump at Garaža "Obilićev venac" from 1 to 402 displayed free spaces [F5] comes from a source that publishes no measurement time [F4], so at 01:35 [F1] I read it as a publishing artifact before I read it as cars.
